title: Secret Service arrests armed Venezuelan migrant near White House over alleged Trump assassination threat
summary: Secret Service officers arrested a Venezuelan migrant in Washington, D.C., after finding firearms in a stolen vehicle and hearing an alleged threat against President Donald Trump.

title: Trump's move from Wiles to Miller signals major tactical shift for governing without Congress
summary: Stephen Miller and Russ Vought have been identifying policies Trump can enact by executive order on immigration, tariffs and government spending.

title: Trump names Stephen Miller new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
summary: Susie Wiles served 21 months as Trump's longest-serving chief of staff across both terms, departing after Republicans lost the House and Senate. Trump announced Stephen Miller will take on the role.

title: Progressive group's 182-page blueprint maps out potential Dem investigations into Trump, corporate allies
summary: Former President Joe Biden aides mapped Tesla, Apple, Amazon and OpenAI as targets for sweeping Democratic congressional investigations into Trump allies.

title: Trump admin sues Penn State over in-state tuition policy for undocumented migrants
summary: The DOJ's lawsuit accuses Pennsylvania State University of offering undocumented students in-state tuition rates that discriminate against U.S. citizens.

title: Federal judge temporarily blocks construction of Trump's Arlington triumphal arch hours after approval
summary: The National Capital Planning Commission had approved construction for President Trump's proposed triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., hours before the restraining order was issued.

title: BOBBY BURACK: Ryan Clark claims ESPN interviewed Sophie Cunningham about trans athletes to impress OutKick
summary: Ryan Clark claims ESPN published a Sophie Cunningham profile about trans athletes in women's sports to impress OutKick after his firing from ESPN.

title: Craig Carton rips Chiefs teammates for not helping embattled Rashee Rice avoid bankruptcy
summary: Rashee Rice filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy with $3.45 million in debts, and Craig Carton is asking why his Chiefs teammates haven't stepped up.

title: World's tallest women's college basketball player makes her debut for Texas Tech
summary: Stephanie Okechukwu posted 10 rebounds and three blocks in her Texas Tech debut, and the NCAA just granted the 7-foot-1 Nigerian four years.

title: Kristaps Porzingis stepping away from basketball amid health issues: 'Not where I want to be'
summary: Kristaps Porzingis cited his ongoing health struggles in his decision to step away, as the Warriors reportedly stopped his $20 million salary payments.
